comments.author: Unreal-Forever
comments.body_html:
I’ll see if I can test this mod today.

My PC is a 10th generation Core i5 10400, with 32gb of Ram and a GTX1070 of 8Gb.

I’ve noticed that my performance problem comes from a bottleneck that is created in the CPU when there are many Bots on the map, mainly in the Factory where I configure the amount of AI to “Horde”, the game does not know how to use all the processor threads, it only uses the physical processors (it only uses 6 threads of the 12 that the processor has), I’ve noticed that by deactivating the HT from the Bios there is an increase in performance since it uses more of the physical cores, but even so it never gets used in its entirety, but when the game starts to lose performance the GPU starts to make less use while the CPU uses more.

This Mod will probably help me a lot.

EDIT:

What I’ve noticed with this mod is that it reduces the amount of bots on the map.

For example, normally when I play in the Factory I set the number of bots to “Horde”, they never stop appearing, but when I use this mod there comes a time when the map is empty and I can’t find anyone, that is, with this mod I can find an average of 40-50 bots in the Factory, while without this mod I can exceed 100.

I have noticed that it doesn’t load the proper amount of bots on the maps because even if they are not rendered they should be loaded in RAM memory, and this doesn’t happen, for example, in large maps I normally set the number of bots to high because I only have 32 Gb of RAM, and activating the “horde” mode causes the RAM memory to be insufficient (except in the Factory), and I have noticed that with this mod in use the RAM memory oscillates between 15-16Gb of memory, which suggests that it is not loading the proper amount of bots.

By having this mod active and configuring Horde it is as if the number of bots is set to high, just as activating high is as if it were medium.
